thread.title: Apple's stock plunge accounts for a third of Dow industrials' 300-point early morning tumble - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Apple's stock plunge accounts for a third of Dow industrials' 300-point early morning tumble - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -10.03% were producing the stiffest headwind for the Dow Jones Industrial Average in early Thursday action after the iPhone maker made a rare cut to its sales forecast. The Cupertino, Calif., tech behemoth was slashing about 100 points from the Dow DJIA, -2.83% with the blue-chip index down 335 points or 1.4%. A dollar move in any one of the Dow's 30 components equates to a roughly 6.8-point swing in the price-weighted index. Apple's decline also was weighing on the broader market, with the S&P 500 SPX, -2.48% off 1.1% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -3.04% down 1.4%. Both of those indexes are market-capitalization weighted and Apple is one of the largest companies in the world by market value ($684 billion).
